Lifetime and ordering:
Exact STRATA_PHASE_HEAD_LEASE=1 is frozen once; other values default OFF. ON requires
existing full qualified phase-cache admission and loaded native head; no MTP/multiGPU/reuse.
8192 fixed gate unchanged. NativeHead adds explicit DrainedReaders contract, separately
frees scratch/weights, preserves immutable reload descriptor, and refuses loaded/double lease.
No destructor tricks, ownership copying, quantization/dtype/CPU SIMD/kernel/COPY changes.

Startup ON skips Prefill::init until GEN admission. Verifier::init still executes with
loaded NativeHead, retaining its object pointer. Inspection of Verifier::init found buffer
allocation/tuning, not head kernel graph capture; record_window is lazy later. Thus startup
never initializes verifier against a null head and never initializes Prefill beside loaded
head. This deferral moves first Prefill init and first lease overhead into prompt_ms.

First GEN: checked phase quiesce (wait_commit/device_sync, producer checks), retire verifier
all graph collections/commit graphs, session and token graphs; explicit head release;
Prefill init (callbacks restored), actual prompt run; successful checked quiesce; Prefill
stats and actual free readings; Prefill reset; session geometry validation; head reload;
cache grow/fill/publish; decode. Subsequent GEN additionally invalidates/unmaps previous
extra cache after graph retirement, then releases head before Prefill reinit. Head remains
absent throughout run AND reset. windows_ok excludes short verifier prompt reads while
leased, preventing fallback reads of skipped canonical output.weight. Verifier retains the
same head object; all old graph pointer arguments are retired and new capture resolves
new weights/type. record_window refuses a retained but unloaded native head.

NativeHead remembers exact source path, containing shard path/file size/data_start/tensor
offset, source GGML type, dims, bytes and converted type. Reload checks metadata plus
in_bounds/tensor_payload_bytes, then repeats unchanged upload and existing conversion.
Lease reload conversion uses wait_and_throw; ordinary OFF conversion keeps existing wait.
Externally pinned model files remain caller contract: metadata cannot detect same-size
content replacement. No huge per-GEN hashing; no retained original RAM tensor.

PhaseServeCycle optional paired release/reload callbacks share actual production orchestration
and PhaseLoggedCall timing. First and subsequent release/reload fall within existing request
clock r0; reload copy/conversion is in head_reload and prompt_ms before decode. Existing
fixed table/session storage remains unchanged. Startup loaded-head/verifier costs precede GEN,
as ordinary startup costs do; deferred Prefill init and lease itself enter first request.
release logs requested weight/scratch bytes plus actual device free before/after; startup
and reload logs original GGML integer type, post-conversion integer type and dimensions.
Hard-coded startup Q5_K label removed. Actual runtime source type/bytes remain unmeasured.

All unsuccessful prompt/cancel/nonfinite/unknown completion follows inherited phase_fatal
_Exit retention. Callback failure poisons cycle and never retries/reloads on uncertain state.
Reload allocation/conversion errors terminate; no recovery or decode using null/stale head.
QUIT follows inherited checked drain, Prefill reset if needed, reader graph destruction,
checked cache close and ordinary native-head destruction. Before first GEN head is loaded,
workspace absent; after successful GEN head loaded/workspace retired. Safely unloaded owner
has null allocation pointers and is destructible only after caller checked completion;
failed/uncertain active GEN does not unwind into QUIT. gpu::free remains its existing checked
Runtime teardown contract (void API, fail-stop on uncertain completion).

Meaningful CPU lifetime fixtures added in existing phase_cache_owner_test.cpp:
Two successful GEN cycles assert absent head while workspace lives and reloaded head only
after workspace retirement. Seven injected boundary callback failures (quiesce, readers,
release, init, prompt quiesce, reset, reload) require poisoned state and no subsequent calls.
Incomplete callback pair rejects before mutation. These exercise production state machine
with synthetic owners; they cannot qualify real GPU quiescence, kernels or physical fit.
